text:
alex-m: Quick check — planning to start the percent-based canary for model_v3 today at 16:00 PT. Plan: 5% -> 20% -> 50% over ~24h. Initial regions: us-west1 + eu-central1. Any objections or additional guardrails?

priya: LGTM. Need explicit abort conditions in the runbook: suggest abort if 5xx delta >= 0.8% over baseline window (10m) OR p95 token_latency +30% vs baseline for 15m. Also add PD paging to SRE-ML.

dan: Confirm automatic fallback to model_v2 is enabled at the routing layer (`fallback=model_v2`). If we see errors we'll route to v2 instantly.

emma: I'll create the rollout in Console and attach the smoke eval set `smoke-prompt-10`. Will also add two automated health checks (latency + error-rate).

ricardo: Note — Dedicated customers must be excluded from this perc ramp. Add a routing segment `is_dedicated=true` -> 0% for model_v3.

alex-m: Flag name we will use: `model_v3_canary`. Kill-switch: `model_v3_canary_disable`. Can we standardize the curl for ops?

priya: Use this one-liner to enable 5%:

```bash
curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood/flags/toggle \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN' \\n  -d '{"flag":"model_v3_canary","enabled":true,"percent":5,"regions":["us-west1","eu-central1"]}'
```

And to abort:

```bash
curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood/flags/toggle \\
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN' \\
  -d '{"flag":"model_v3_canary","enabled":false}'
```

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] feature-flag command received: prepare model_v3_canary (awaiting commit).

ops-alert: [ops-alert] FYI — I'll emit an FYI metric and page if thresholds hit.

alex-m: Proposal for timing between jumps: wait 45m after enabling, run two 15m check windows, then jump. If we see transient blips, give 10m stabilization, otherwise abort. Thoughts?

priya: 45m + 2 checks sounds good. Add trace tagging `canary:model_v3` so Emma/SRE can filter quickly.

dan: PR opened to ensure product-dev has read-only access to rollout status: https://git/redwood/infra/rollouts/pull/482

emma: I'll update the runbook section and add the abort checklist to /docs/runbooks/canary-rollouts.md.

alex-m: Ok rolling at 16:00 PT. @priya please enable and paste the Console + traces links here when live. :rocket:

priya: enabling now. posting the command + links.

priya: DONE — 5% enabled. Console: https://console.redwood/rollouts/abc123 Traces filter: https://console.redwood/traces?tag=canary:model_v3

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] rollout event: model_v3_canary -> enabled 5% (us-west1, eu-central1) by priya at 2026-03-17T23:00:25Z

ops-alert: [ops-alert] metric watch: error_rate delta trending +0.9% vs baseline (10m window) — approaching abort threshold.

emma: digging into logs: `model-serving-v3` timeouts spiking in eu-central1. Pulling stack traces now.

dan: Because we have the fallback route to model_v2, we could let it run 5 more minutes to see whether errors stabilize or keep climbing.

alex-m: If it stays above threshold, abort. We're at +0.9% now which matches the abort condition. Priya, can you flip the kill-switch?

priya: Aborting now. Running:

```bash
curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood/flags/toggle \\
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN' \\
  -d '{"flag":"model_v3_canary","enabled":false}'
```

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] feature-flag update: model_v3_canary -> disabled by priya at 2026-03-17T23:07:15Z

priya: rollback completed. PD notified: pd://team-sre-ml/incident-2026-03-17-01

emma: Incident created and logs attached. Root cause investigation in progress; preliminary: increased tail latency due to a config mismatch in KV cache sharding in eu.

ricardo: I've applied a temporary region exclusion for eu-central1 for any traffic to model_v3. Also alerted account teams for Dedicated customers about the exclusion.

alex-m: Good response. We'll wait for the SRE RCA. Plan: block eu, keep us-west1 disabled as well until we have a patch and a repeatable smoke pass. Re-assess tomorrow.

priya: I'll update the rollout entry with timestamps and actions. Also adding a note to attach the smoke eval run results when we re-run.

dan: Thx all. PRs and runbook edits are linked in thread. If SRE gives a clean bill, we'll re-schedule a smaller canary with only us-west1 and 2% traffic.

alex-m: Thanks — excellent coordination. Closing this thread for now. Ping here for re-open. :thumbsup:

emma: ack.

ricardo: ack.

priya: ack and logging follow-up tasks.
